event_text: Ernesto’s closed on Thursday, August 27, 2015, due to a small fire. Upon inspection by the Health Inspector, a roach infestation was found inside the building. The owners repaired the damage from the fire and complied with the requirement to fumigate the premise. Weekly fumigation must be performed and reported to the Health Inspector for the next four (4) weeks. The restaurant was allowed to reopen on Friday, August 28, 2015.
